name: Soho Grand Hotel
insider_take: A pioneering boutique hotel that transformed an industrial cast-iron district into Manhattan's most creative neighborhood hub.
whats_special: The Soho Grand was the first major hotel to open in SoHo in over a century, featuring a stunning bottle-green glass staircase and allowing pets (they even offer goldfish for guests). The lobby showcases original mastodon fossils, and the building's cast-iron architecture reflects the neighborhood's rich industrial heritage.
pro_tip: Visit the rooftop for panoramic views of the Hudson River and downtown skyline – it's one of the few hotels in SoHo offering this elevated perspective of the cobblestone streets below.
dont_miss: Exploring the world-renowned art galleries within walking distance, shopping the high-end boutiques along Broadway and Spring Street, and experiencing the vibrant nightlife scene that made SoHo famous among artists and creatives.
pros: Prime SoHo location with easy access to shopping and dining
Pet-friendly with exceptional amenities for furry companions
Historic industrial charm with modern luxury touches
Excellent rooftop terrace and bar with city views
cons: Urban location with typical city noise levels
Premium pricing reflective of Manhattan location
